{{Top|sprot|leg}}
'''Sperm''' was a type of gamete involved in the [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]] of certain [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="COTG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> during which it was often paired with [[Ovum|ova]].<ref name="DFJK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> In several species, sperm was produced by [[Gender/Legends|males]] and ova by females;<ref name="COTG" /> in others, the same individual produced both sperm and eggs. For instance, the [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]]-based [[shadow barnacle]] of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] released both egg [[Seed/Legends|seeds]] and sperm [[pollen]] into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to reproduce.<ref name="WOSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

Females of the [[Ghest/Legends|ghest]] species of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] could mate with a male or extract sperm from a [[Death/Legends|dead]] male to self-inseminate, leading to the laying of fertilized [[Egg/Legends|eggs]].<ref name="COTG" /> [[Bioengineering/Legends|Genetic engineering]] of the [[gra]] species for culvitation by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings was so extensive that gra sperm and ova were sold "by the herd" with instruction manuals.<ref name="DFJK" />
